purpose: Give every dual-witness page a deterministic terminal machine disposition. Exact pages may advance; conflicts are conclusively omitted rather than left in a human or third-engine queue.

adjudication_lanes.dual_witness_exact: When normalized full text, protected headings and numeric sequences agree and all source bindings pass, the full page may enter the publication manifest.
adjudication_lanes.text_conflict_fail_closed: Any non-table text conflict receives a terminal machine receipt and is omitted from publication. No human or third-engine queue remains.
adjudication_lanes.table_conflict_fail_closed: A detected table is omitted unless the full page passes the exact non-table gate; the receipt preserves the table flag and protected-field conflict state.
adjudication_lanes.dual_zero_text_blank: Two empty OCR witnesses bound to the same rendered page produce a terminal non-text disposition. Blank pages emit no quotable text.
adjudication_lanes.binding_failure_blocks_build: A source PDF, physical page, OCR artifact, independent witness or rendered-image identity mismatch aborts the build.
